title: 🌤️ Weather Forecast for Malta (October 5–11, 2025)
author: Dad
excerpt: A sunny and breezy week ahead in Malta, with temperatures ranging from 16°C to 26°C.
content:
☀️ Sunday, October 5: Increasingly windy with clouds giving way to some sun. High: 26°C, Low: 20°C.

🌤️ Monday, October 6: Mostly sunny, windy, and less humid. High: 26°C, Low: 18°C.

🌞 Tuesday, October 7: Breezy and pleasant with plenty of sunshine. High: 24°C, Low: 17°C.

🌤️ Wednesday, October 8: Pleasant with plenty of sunshine; breezy in the afternoon. High: 25°C, Low: 16°C.

☁️ Thursday, October 9: Mostly cloudy. High: 26°C, Low: 18°C.

🌞 Friday, October 10: Mostly sunny. High: 27°C, Low: 19°C.

🌦️ Saturday, October 11: A couple of morning showers; otherwise, sunshine and some clouds. High: 26°C, Low: 19°C.
